## Motivation

Port the upstream chat-encoding fix [deepseek-ai/DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash@314113f](https://huggingface.co/deepseek-ai/DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash/commit/314113f8a7dadb388215396ba5fbee2c610a04d6) into the V4.1 prompt encoder, which has the same two bugs:

1. **Tool-result images out of order.** `encode_messages()` collected images before tool messages were merged and tool results re-sorted by call order. When tool results arrive out of `tool_call` order and carry images, the prompt's `<｜deepseek_image｜>` placeholders are reordered but the returned image list keeps arrival order, so images bind to the wrong placeholders.
2. **`drop_thinking` drops current-turn reasoning across tool calls.** A merged tool-result-only user message counted as a new user turn, so the reasoning of the current-turn assistant message preceding the tool results was stripped. Tool results alone do not start a new user turn; the current turn's reasoning should be kept until a real new user request arrives.

## Modifications

In `python/sglang/srt/entrypoints/openai/encoding_dsv41.py`:

- `encode_messages` validates textual fields for image placeholders, then merges tool messages and sorts tool results by call order, and only then collects images — the returned image list now matches the placeholder order in the prompt.
- `merge_tool_messages` keeps structured tool content (list `content` / `content_blocks`) instead of flattening it to joined text.
- `find_last_user_index` skips user messages holding only tool results, so `drop_thinking` keeps the current turn's reasoning across tool calls and drops it once a new user request arrives. The existing `developer`-as-user-turn behavior is kept.

## Accuracy Tests

Prompt-encoding logic only; no model forward / kernel changes. Unit tests in `test/registered/unit/entrypoints/openai/test_serving_chat.py`:

- `test_dsv41_tool_result_images_follow_prompt_order` — 4 input formats (`content_blocks`, `tool_messages`, `tool_content_blocks`, `context`); asserts prompt-tail order, media URL order, and that inputs are not mutated. Subtests fail on pre-fix code.
- `test_dsv41_drop_thinking_without_tools` — current-turn reasoning kept across a tool result, dropped once a real new user turn arrives. Fails on pre-fix code.
- `test_dsv41_rejects_image_placeholder_in_text` — placeholder rejection for `user` and `tool` messages.

`test_serving_chat.py` full run: 159 passed. `test_deepseekv41_detector.py`: 10 passed. pre-commit clean.

## Checklist

- [x] Format your code according to the [Format code with pre-commit](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#format-code-with-pre-commit).
- [x] Add unit tests according to the [Run and add unit tests](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#run-and-add-unit-tests).
- [ ] Update documentation according to [Write documentations](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#write-documentations).
- [ ] Provide accuracy and speed benchmark results according to [Test the accuracy](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#test-the-accuracy) and [Benchmark the speed](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#benchmark-the-speed).
- [x] Follow the SGLang code style [guidance](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#code-style-guidance).

+    def test_dsv41_rejects_image_placeholder_in_text(self):
+        from sglang.srt.entrypoints.openai import encoding_dsv41
+
+        for role in ("user", "tool"):
+            with self.subTest(role=role):
+                with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
+                    encoding_dsv41.encode_messages(
+                        [
+                            {
+                                "role": role,
+                                "content": f"hi {encoding_dsv41.IMAGE_PLACEHOLDER}",
+                            }
+                        ],
+                        thinking_mode="chat",
+                    )
+
+    def test_dsv41_tool_result_images_follow_prompt_order(self):
+        """Out-of-order tool results are sorted by call order; images must follow."""
+        from sglang.srt.entrypoints.openai import encoding_dsv41
+
+        image = encoding_dsv41.IMAGE_PLACEHOLDER
+        history = [
+            {
+                "role": "user",
+                "content": [
+                    {"type": "image_url", "image_url": {"url": "history.png"}},
+                ],
+            },
+            {
+                "role": "assistant",
+                "tool_calls": [
+                    {
+                        "id": name,
+                        "type": "function",
+                        "function": {"name": name, "arguments": "{}"},
+                    }
+                    for name in ("a", "b")
+                ],
+            },
+        ]
+        results = [
+            {
+                "type": "tool_result",
+                "tool_use_id": name,
+                "content": [
+                    {"type": "text", "text": f"result {name}"},
+                    {"type": "image_url", "image_url": {"url": f"{name}.png"}},
+                ],
+            }
+            for name in ("b", "a")
+        ]
+
+        for input_format in (
+            "content_blocks",
+            "tool_messages",
+            "tool_content_blocks",
+            "context",
+        ):
+            with self.subTest(input_format=input_format):
+                if input_format in ("tool_messages", "tool_content_blocks"):
+                    content_field = (
+                        "content_blocks"
+                        if input_format == "tool_content_blocks"
+                        else "content"
+                    )
+                    messages = history + [
+                        {
+                            "role": "tool",
+                            "tool_call_id": block["tool_use_id"],
+                            content_field: block["content"],
+                        }
+                        for block in results
+                    ]
+                    context = []
+                elif input_format == "context":
+                    messages = [{"role": "user", "content_blocks": results}]
+                    context = history
+                else:
+                    messages = history + [{"role": "user", "content_blocks": results}]
+                    context = []
+                original = copy.deepcopy((messages, context))
+
+                prompt, media = encoding_dsv41.encode_messages(
+                    messages,
+                    thinking_mode="chat",
+                    context=context,
+                    return_multi_modal_data=True,
+                )
+
+                self.assertTrue(
+                    prompt.endswith(
+                        f"<｜User｜><tool_result>result a\n\n{image}</tool_result>\n\n"
+                        f"<tool_result>result b\n\n{image}</tool_result>"
+                        "<｜Assistant｜></think>"
+                    ),
+                    prompt,
+                )
+                expected_urls = (
+                    ["a.png", "b.png"] if context else ["history.png", "a.png", "b.png"]
+                )
+                self.assertEqual(
+                    media,
+                    {"images": [{"url": url} for url in expected_urls]},
+                )
+                self.assertEqual((messages, context), original)
+
+    def test_dsv41_drop_thinking_without_tools(self):
+        """Tool results do not start a new turn, so current-turn reasoning is kept."""
+        from sglang.srt.entrypoints.openai import encoding_dsv41
+
+        messages = [
+            {"role": "user", "content": "q1"},
+            {"role": "assistant", "content": "a1", "reasoning_content": "r1"},
+            {"role": "user", "content": "q2"},
+            {
+                "role": "assistant",
+                "reasoning_content": "r2",
+                "tool_calls": [
+                    {
+                        "id": "c1",
+                        "type": "function",
+                        "function": {"name": "lookup", "arguments": "{}"},
+                    }
+                ],
+            },
+            {"role": "tool", "tool_call_id": "c1", "content": "value"},
+        ]
+        prompt = encoding_dsv41.encode_messages(
+            messages, thinking_mode="thinking", drop_thinking=True
+        )
+        self.assertIn(
+            "<｜User｜>q1<｜Assistant｜></think>a1<｜end▁of▁sentence｜>", prompt
+        )
+        self.assertNotIn("r1", prompt)
+        self.assertIn("<think>r2</think>", prompt)
+        self.assertTrue(
+            prompt.endswith("<tool_result>value</tool_result><｜Assistant｜><think>")
+        )
+
+        next_turn = encoding_dsv41.encode_messages(
+            messages + [{"role": "user", "content": "q3"}],
+            thinking_mode="thinking",
+        )
+        self.assertNotIn("r2", next_turn)
+        self.assertTrue(next_turn.endswith("q3<｜Assistant｜><think>"))
+
